text:
maya: Quick planning thread for next week's cross-channel seeding (LinkedIn + X) around the webinar + benchmark narrative. Need final copy, hero visual, and who owns engagement follow-ups. :rocket:

sam: lgtm — i've got two copy variants, will paste in a min. do we have an official hashtag?

maya: Not locked. Thinking #RedwoodBench or #InferenceAtScale. leaning toward short.

priyanka: #InferenceAtScale reads clearer to enterprise buyers. also we should add UTMs for the webinar CTA. can we standardize utm_campaign=webinar_may2026&utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}?

jordan: +1 on utm params. also what are the posting windows? timezone spread?

maya: proposal: wave 1 (teaser): Mon 09:00 PT X, 12:00 PT LinkedIn. wave 2 (reminder): Wed 11:30 PT X thread + LinkedIn afternoon. day-of: 90m before + 15m before.

max: for X we should do a short 4-tweet thread for the benchmark highlights, then link to webinar. for LinkedIn single post + 2 comment followups works.

sam: copy A (short): "We just benchmarked open LLMs for low-latency inference. See how model choice + serving configs change cost and latency. Join our webinar to dig in -> [link] #InferenceAtScale"

sam: copy B (narrative): "Benchmarks are noisy. We ran controlled inferences to compare latency, throughput, and cost across model families. Join our webinar where we share reproducible configs, tips for real traffic, and what we changed to cut token costs by 3x. Register: [link]"

maya: both good. prefer B for LinkedIn org post, A for X headline. then expand into a thread for X.

priyanka: Asset list: hero 1200x628 PNG, 16:9 30s clip (mp4) with pull quote, small speaker headshots, and a one-slide TL;DR for the thread. can design deliver by Fri EOD?

jordan: i can get headshots + TL;DR. who owns the hero image?

maya: @max can you own hero & 30s clip? design brief: show latency vs cost tradeoff visual, include Redwood logo, CTA text = "Register: [short link]".

max: yes, I'll take it. timeline: mock by Thu, final Fri EOD. will post an export-ready folder in Figma and drop the link here. :camera_flash:

priyanka: i'll prep UTM suffixes and a tracking sheet. can we add a 'lead source' tag in the webinar form so sales can route?

maya: yes add lead_source=social_{platform}_may2026. Sales routing: engage->sdR->enterprise as we discussed.

sam: engagement plan: 1) official post, 2) comment from speaker 3-4 hrs later with reminder, 3) follow-up replay clip + benchmark snapshot 24h after. who posts speaker comment?

jordan: speaker comments should come from the speaker's personal LinkedIn/X to get reach. i'll coordinate with speakers to have a short one-liner ready.

max: for X thread structure i suggest: tweet 1 = headline + CTA, tweet 2 = benchmark top-line stat, tweet 3 = quick methodology note, tweet 4 = registration link + speaker callout. keep each under 280 and use visuals on tweet 2 or 4.

maya: perfect. Sam — can you drop the thread copy and the LinkedIn long copy here by EOD? I'll do a final pass Monday morning and then schedule with the scheduler.

sam: will do. also attaching suggested CTAs: "Register now", "Save your seat", and "See the benchmark" — which do we prioritize?

priyanka: "Register now" for primary CTA, "See the benchmark" for follow-up replay assets.

maya: approved. Scheduling note: scheduler-bot, do not auto-post before assets folder is marked ready. we will manually trigger first wave.

social-bot: Scheduler check: next available slot reserved for marketing on Mon 09:00 PT. To confirm post, react with :white_check_mark:.

maya: confirmed. everyone please review copy & assets by Thu so design has time. I'll ping speakers for comment drafts. :calendar:

sam: pasted thread draft here for X (4 tweets):
```
1/ We benchmarked open LLMs for low-latency inference and measured how model choice + serving config impacts latency & cost. Join our webinar to see reproducible configs. Register: https://rwd.co/webinar-may2026 #InferenceAtScale
2/ Top result: Q8 quant + batching + KV caching cut median latency by 35% on common traffic shapes. Visual: [image]
3/ Method: controlled workloads, same seq lengths, identical VMs. We'll share scripts + perf artifacts in the session.
4/ Save your seat -> https://rwd.co/webinar-may2026 @speaker1 @speaker2
```

maya: that's clean. two small asks: replace speaker handles with real ones before scheduling and shorten link to rwd.co short link. otherwise good.

priyanka: added UTM example for the sheet: https://rwd.co/webinar-may2026?utm_campaign=webinar_may2026&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_content=tweet1

jordan: budget note: can we set a small paid boost on LinkedIn for the reminder post targeted to platform engineers and infrastructure leads? $500 cap, run Wed-Thu.

maya: sounds fine. @growth please confirm paid allocation — i'll loop in separately.

max: dropping the Figma link when mock is up. also creating a 9:16 clip variant for stories where we can run short promos.

sam: once copy finalized, pls add to scheduling doc with: platform, post time, copy variant, asset file names, UTMs, owner. i'll take on scheduling once assets are in place.

maya: thanks team — checklist summary: Sam: final copy + thread draft (EOD Thu). Max: hero + 30s clip + 9:16 by Fri EOD. Priyanka: UTMs + tracking sheet by Thu. Jordan: speaker comments + boost ask. I'll coordinate scheduling and sales routing. Will re-open thread Monday for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:

jordan: +1. thanks all.

sam: thx!

social-bot: Reminder set for Thu 16:00 PT to collect final approvals.
